01 — About Me

The Artist Behind the Craft

"I am Suhani Soni — a first-year fashion designing student with a lifelong devotion to visual storytelling. My art styles, from intricate mandala patterns and devotional deity illustrations to vibrant anime fan art and contemporary fashion sketches."

My work reflects my cultural roots and creative curiosity. Whether it's a pencil sketch of Lord Ram, a Picasso-inspired abstract in blues, or a detailed fashion illustration — each piece carries my signature style.
